content.rendered: In this Kinder newsletter, you will find information needed for a successful start to the 2024-25 school year for your soon-to-be Kindergarten student. Information includes the beginning of the year schedule, registration information, supply lists and more. Incoming Kinder families will receive an email over the summer regarding their orientation session. Please be sure to register your student as soon as possible, to ensure you receive information emailed out directly to families.
